title: Non-Destructive Pre-Staging External Smoke Proof Gate
statusRationale: The non-destructive smoke gate is implemented and fail-closed. Current public HTTPS JSON and browser proof routes pass, but 1e100.network currently serves the JSON proof route over plain HTTP without redirecting to HTTPS. The upstream cache/provider prerequisite is also blocked because proof/control routes show provider cache-hit or nonzero Age evidence despite declaring Cache-Control no-store. These blockers prevent staging-specific enablement until corrected or explicitly reclassified by a later human decision.

blockers.observed: Plain HTTP GET to /.well-known/usf-public-edge.json returned HTTP 200 instead of redirecting to HTTPS.
blockers.requiredOperatorAction: Configure the public edge or origin for 1e100.network so HTTP requests to proof/control routes redirect to the same host over HTTPS, or record a later explicit human-approved reclassification.

blockers.observed: Proof/control routes declare Cache-Control no-store but provider evidence includes cache hit or nonzero Age observations.
blockers.requiredOperatorAction: Configure the public edge or origin so proof/control routes are not served from provider cache when Cache-Control is no-store, or record a later explicit human-approved bounded rationale.

blockers.observed: Repository access cannot collect external provider access logs.
blockers.requiredOperatorAction: Before any staging readiness claim, attach provider or origin access-log evidence with safe redaction, retention, and correlation boundaries, or record a later approved bounded rationale.
